say:1:1711109001:1.text: Hmph... These days, everyone claims to be a follower of Emperor Roland!
say:1:1711109001:1.source_cn: 哼……这年头，谁都说自己是罗兰大帝的追随者！

say:2:1711109002:0.text: But whether they are true followers or not, we can make our own judgment!
say:2:1711109002:0.source_cn: 但究竟是不是真正的追随者，我们自有判断！

choice_prompt:8:1711109006.text: Show us the support that will satisfy us, make the Emperor pause, and turn the city's attention! Prove the depth of your fervor!
choice_prompt:8:1711109006.source_cn: 展现出令我们满意、令大帝驻足、令全城侧目的应援吧！证明你狂热的深度！

say:10:1711109008:1.text: Listen up! If you're not one of those pseudo-believers who only talk the talk, then prove it with your actions!
say:10:1711109008:1.source_cn: 听好了！如果你不是那些只会动嘴皮子的伪信徒，就用行动来证明！

choice_prompt:12:1711109009.text: Right here! In this sacred area! Wave your glow sticks toward the statue of Roland the Great!
choice_prompt:12:1711109009.source_cn: 就在这里！在这个神圣的区域！向着罗兰大帝的雕像，挥舞荧光棒吧！

say:13:1711109010:1.text: What? Hesitating? True love doesn't hesitate!
say:13:1711109010:1.source_cn: 怎么？犹豫了？真正的爱是不会犹豫的！

choice:12:0:1.text: ...Do you really want to wave it?

say:15:1711109011:1.text: Oh! Your eyes have changed! These are the eyes of enlightenment! Quick, let us see your sincerity!
say:15:1711109011:1.source_cn: 哦！你的眼神变了！这是觉悟的眼神！快，让我们看看你的诚意！

choice:12:1:2.text: For a clue... I'll risk it all!
